method: Classify all mutually exclusive Studio-reported attribution rows in one channel and observation window before computing shares. A risk index is a descriptive diagnostic, not observed income risk.

source_families.label: Browse
source_families.source: YouTube Home, Subscriptions, Watch Later, Explore and other browse surfaces

source_families.label: Suggested videos
source_families.source: Recommendations adjacent to or after videos and links in descriptions

source_families.label: Notifications
source_families.source: Notification/email referrals; subscriber notifications are not the subscriber count

source_families.label: Playlists
source_families.source: Creator or other curated playlists, including liked/favorite videos

source_families.label: External
source_families.source: Links/embeds from external websites or applications

source_families.label: Direct or unknown
source_families.source: Bookmarks, direct URLs, signed-out viewers and unidentified apps

source_families.label: Other Studio source classes
source_families.source: Remaining channel pages, cards, remixes, sound pages, ads and product placements when reported

descriptive_indices.formula: largest reported source view count / total attributed views
descriptive_indices.interpretation: Share attributed to largest distinct reported source; do not infer independent control of that source.

descriptive_indices.formula: sum of squared fractions across all disjoint reported source categories
descriptive_indices.interpretation: Descriptive source concentration; different taxonomy granularity changes its value.
Only a mathematical equivalent, not the number of algorithms or independently owned audience paths.

risk_conditions: Owner-only Studio rows cannot establish competitor source concentration.
Browse features mix Home and subscriptions; do not label entire browse category algorithmic recommendation.
Suggested videos can include description links; do not treat the category as exclusively automated suggestions.
Direct/unknown can include signed-out viewers and unidentified apps; do not declare those independently owned or a deliberate direct audience.
Shares of views are not shares of revenue, watch time, unique people, sponsor conversions or net profit.
Include reported paid promotions and all traffic source classes rather than excluding inconvenient categories to raise or lower a share.
Shorts and long-form viewer sources and the 2026 view definition revision require separate windows/format-specific analysis.
HHI depends on the partition's detail level; no universal safe threshold or creator success probability is established.

research_gates.reason: No channel owner data supplied or collected
Complete counts and explicit zero rows are not available
A consistent channel/metric/format window has not been measured
No joint revenue, disruptions, retention or causal outcomes measured
